name: @codemod.com/orchestration
description: TypeScript prototype of the Codemod orchestration runtime (static composition, workflows, replay history) run in a sandboxed QuickJS runtime

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:quickjs && CODEMOD_QUICKJS_E2E=1 vitest run tests/quickjs.e2e.test.ts tests/jssg-parity.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:timings: cargo build -p orchestration-quickjs-host --features orchestration-quickjs-host/timings && CODEMOD_TIMINGS_E2E=1 vitest run tests/timings.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:quickjs: pnpm build:quickjs && CODEMOD_QUICKJS_E2E=1 vitest run tests/quickjs.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:live:agent:builtin: pnpm build:agent && CODEMOD_LIVE_AGENT_BUILTIN=1 vitest run tests/agent.builtin.live.test.ts
scripts.test:live:agent:claude-code: pnpm build:agent && CODEMOD_LIVE_AGENT_CLAUDE_CODE=1 vitest run tests/agent.claude-code.live.test.ts
scripts.test:live:agent:codex: pnpm build:agent && CODEMOD_LIVE_AGENT_CODEX=1 vitest run tests/agent.codex.live.test.ts
